subject: Learning Methods
title: Study Before Sleep Strategy
description: Learn Study Before Sleep Strategy in one minute.

hook.text: Students who reviewed material 30 minutes before bed and tested the next morning outperformed those who studied in.

buildup.text: Studying before sleep gives the brain the freshest material to consolidate.

discovery.text: This works best for review, not for first-time learning of difficult material.

twist.text: The pre-sleep review should be low-effort. Flashcards, summaries, or simple re-testing work best.

climax.text: Make a pre-sleep review your final study act. Ten minutes of flashcards before the lights go out can double retention.

punchline.text: Review before sleep. Let your brain do the overnight filing.

quiz.question: Why should pre-sleep study be review rather than new difficult material?
options: New material requires more light which disrupts melatonin
Difficult material causes stress that can disrupt sleep quality
The brain cannot learn anything new within one hour of bedtime
